name: What needs to be done to my kitchen before the countertop installers arrive?
description: Before installers arrive, existing countertops must be removed, base cabinets fully installed and leveled, and any temporary plumbing/electrical completed.

mainEntity.name: What needs to be done to my kitchen before the countertop installers arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before countertop installers arrive, it's crucial that your existing countertops are removed, and all base cabinets are fully installed, leveled, and secured. Any temporary plumbing or electrical work should also be completed to ensure a clear and safe workspace. Frasheski Construction provides a detailed checklist to help you prepare your space, ensuring the installation can proceed efficiently without delays. This preparation ensures accuracy during templating and a smooth installation day.
